One can support all of those while opposing elective abortion.
Therefore opposing abortion does not mean opposing reproductive health.
For example, many pro-life physicians and organizations advocate for:
prenatal care,
high-risk obstetrics,
treatment for ectopic pregnancy,
miscarriage management,
maternal health initiatives,
infertility evaluation and treatment,
cancer screening,
contraception (depending on the individual or organization).
Because of that, calling every pro-life person or every opponent of abortion "anti-reproductive health" overstates what their position necessarily entails.
